basis: D. aesculapii AT supported lengths 0.586,2.139,15.642,18.306,22.304 kb; 10 kb separates the observed long/short groups
both congener GC distributions form a continuum; 10 kb is a rounded descriptive stratum, not a natural breakpoint
same within-species cutoff for both families; exact covered length and gaps retained
do not force one AT or two GC per chromosome
limits: non-T2T assembly completeness constrains observed region size
different primary cutoffs disallow direct species abundance comparisons
D. kyathit AT has only one supported 424 bp component; kept as short evidence, not promoted to large
